priorityList: Ensure Raise Dead is active before combat.
Maintain Virulent Plague on the target using Outbreak.
Cast Army of the Dead as your primary cooldown.
Cast Dark Transformation whenever Army of the Dead is active or if Army of the Dead has more than 30 seconds remaining on its cooldown.
Use offensive Trinkets, Potions, and Racials while Army of the Dead or Dark Transformation is active.
Cast Soul Reaper if the target is below 35% health.
Cast Putrefy if you have maximum charges or if Dark Transformation will not be available for at least 15 seconds.
If talented into Festering Scythe, use Festering Strike if the Festering Scythe buff or debuff is about to expire.
Cast Death Coil if Sudden Doom is active or if you have fewer than 2 Runes available.
Use Festering Strike if you have 0 stacks of Lesser Ghoul Ready to prepare a Rider of the Apocalypse summon.
Use Scourge Strike if you have 1 or more stacks of Lesser Ghoul Ready to summon a Rider of the Apocalypse.
Cast Death Coil as your primary Runic Power spender to avoid capping.
Use Festering Strike as a filler only if you need to generate Runic Power and have no Lesser Ghoul Ready stacks.
